author: Unity
description:
The Unity plugin is officially live in the Plugin marketplace in Antigravity.

Through our partnership with Google Antigravity, we're making it seamless to bring real-time 3D development directly into powerful agentic workflows. Instead of navigating fragmented multi-step setups, developers can now connect Unity to Antigravity with a single click.

We know how important it is to connect the tools you already rely on, and this brings agentic workflows straight into your build pipeline.

🔗 Learn more: https://on.unity.com/Antigravity_Blog
